Daily Digest Tuesday, May 19, 2026

Google Marketing Live Unveils Agentic Commerce, ChatGPT Ads Open to All, Meta Poised to Dethrone Google

Google

  1. 1

    Google Marketing Live 2026: "Agentic Commerce" Rewrites the Playbook

    Tomorrow's keynote is built around the "Gemini advantage" — campaigns built, optimized, and managed by AI agents alongside human marketers. The Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), already live with Wayfair, Target, and Walmart, enables checkout directly inside AI Mode. For PMMs: the value of manual execution is compressing. What matters now is data quality, creative assets, and feed cleanliness. Google's AI decides based on your inputs.

    Read on Search Engine Land ↗
  2. 2

    ChatGPT Ads: Self-Serve Opens to Any Budget

    The $50,000 minimum is gone. As of May 5, any U.S. advertiser can access ads.openai.com, set their own budget, and run campaigns with CPC bidding ($3-5/click). The killer differentiator: ads appear inside active research conversations — users comparing CRMs, planning trips, or evaluating services. That's decision-stage intent that search keywords have never quite delivered. OpenAI targets $2.5B in ad revenue for 2026.

    Read on Search Engine Journal ↗
  3. 3

    Meta Set to Overtake Google in Global Ad Revenue

    For the first time ever, Meta is projected to generate $243.46B in 2026 ad revenue vs. Google's $239.54B, according to eMarketer. This isn't just a symbolic milestone — it signals a fundamental shift in where ad dollars flow. Meta's AI-driven Advantage+ campaigns and Instagram/Reels momentum are driving the surge. PMMs: budget allocation conversations just got more interesting.

    Read on B2the7 ↗
  4. 4

    OpenAI Adds Product Feed Ads: E-Commerce Gets Easier

    One week after launching self-serve, OpenAI introduced product feed ads — letting retailers generate ads directly from their product catalogues inside ChatGPT. No more building creative one-by-one. Connect your feed, and the AI handles generation. This lowers the barrier for e-commerce brands testing conversational AI as an ad channel.

    Read on Search Engine Land ↗
  5. 5

    Jonomor Launches "AI Presence" for Enterprise Marketing Automation

    New platform bundles nine content engines (press releases, LinkedIn, blog, Reddit, X, etc.) with AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — ensuring your brand appears correctly in AI-generated answers. Monthly citation monitoring tracks how often you surface in LLM responses. Built on NVIDIA NemoClaw for policy guardrails. Pricing starts at $99/month. The week that changes everything. Google Marketing Live + ChatGPT ads opening wide + Meta overtaking Google — this is the most consequential week for digital advertising since Performance Max launched. For PMMs: if your team isn't testing ChatGPT ads yet, the barrier just dropped to zero. And if you're still manually optimizing campaigns that AI agents could handle, tomorrow's Google keynote is your wake-up call.
